verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public API hosted at api.incident.io with API-key authentication. Its reference covers endpoints, examples, rate limits and error handling, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, with separate Status Page and Widget APIs. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths don't contradict the documented spec download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a verified machine-readable spec location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The API is hosted at `https://api.incident.io/`, and you will need an API key from your incident.io dashboard to make requests.
This is the API reference for incident.io. It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
Download the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec to generate

incident.io provides two APIs for status pages: the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows, and the Widget API for embedding status data into your own product.
